content.overview: Bailment is delivery of goods for a purpose with a condition of return or directed disposal (s. 148). Pledge is bailment as security for a debt or promise (s. 172).

sections.heading: Bailment duties
sections.body: Bailee must take care as a man of ordinary prudence would of his own goods (s. 151) and avoid unauthorised use.

sections.heading: Pledge
sections.body: Pawnee may retain and, on default, sell after notice (s. 176), accounting for surplus.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Plead delivery, purpose, and breach of care or wrongful sale. Document notice before pledge sale.
